title: Superintendent Engineer
desc:
Wärtsilä Energy leads the transition towards a 100% renewable energy future. We help our partners to accelerate their decarbonisation journeys through our market-leading technologies and power system modelling expertise. These cover decarbonisation services, future-fuel enabled balancing power plants, hybrid solutions, energy storage and optimisation technology, including the GEMS Digital Energy Platform.
Did you know Wärtsilä has delivered 79 GW of power plant capacity and more than 130 energy storage installations in 180 countries around the world?
In this fast changing world of energy, we are constantly on the lookout for future-oriented talent to join our team and to work towards enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services - together. Want to join the ride?
We are looking for a
Superintendent Engineer
based in
Istanbul (Turkey)
to lead and execute field service activities for our customers in the energy sectors.
You’ll take end-to-end ownership of on-site overhauls, repairs, and troubleshooting, inspire teams to perform at their best, and ensure every engagement is safe, efficient, and memorable for our customers.
What Will You Be Doing
As
Superintendent Engineer, your work
will focus on these responsibilities:
Perform Field Service activities according to the work plan.
Lead teams and projects with proven, hands-on leadership in the field.
Perform overhauls and repairs on assemblies on site and/or in workshops.
Interact professionally with customers during work’s execution, ensuring clear communication and alignment.
Provide internal and external progress status updates on the assigned work.
Create accurate and timely Service Work Reports.
Ensure that all work is executed according to QSHE guidelines and site procedures and policies.
Follow up and report on the status of work orders to customers and/or internal stakeholders.
Continuously seek solutions according to best practices, driving quality, reliability, and cost effectiveness.
Demonstrate cost awareness and effectiveness in planning and execution.
Utilize Deliver Solutions to Customers processes and tools to ensure consistent service delivery.
To be successful in this role, we expect you to have:
Degree in Mechanical Engineering or Marine Engineering.
Relevant technical education or qualifications as a combination of education and at least 10 years of experience.
Technical experience in marine engineering with strong, practical problem-solving skills.
Proven experience in installation, operation, maintenance, and repair in marine/energy applications.
Proven leadership skills, with experience leading engineers and projects in the field.
Highly effective technical communication skills, both written and verbal.
Fluent in Turkish and English, both written and verbal.
Proficiency in computer applications and digital reporting tools.
Strong communication and teamwork skills; able to collaborate across functions and cultures.
Cost awareness and effectiveness in planning and time management.
Willingness and ability to travel up to 80%, often at short notice, and work in varied site conditions.
Completion of military service is required.
As an ideal candidate you might also have…
Knowledge and experience of Wärtsilä engines is an advantage, especially SG Gas Engines.
Experience working with electrical systems is beneficial.
What we offer:
A front-line role with significant impact on customer satisfaction and asset performance.
Opportunities to work with advanced engine and power solutions, including gas engine technologies.
A diverse, international environment with strong safety culture and support for continuous learning.
In this role, some travel is required to meet with our customers around the world. Thus, we hope you to be ready to travel (approximately 80% time in a year).
Why you and us?
You are valued – as your true self. At Wärtsilä YOU matter. We value diversity and are committed in supporting inclusive work community.
Your growth is supported. We believe in continuous learning & teamwork. Wärtsilian community has your back when it comes to development opportunities – so you can develop beyond your potential.
You get to make a difference. Innovation and sustainability are important for us. Every day, we - Wärtsilians - put our hearts and minds into enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services into reality.
Contact & next steps:
Does this sound like the job for you? If yes, submit your application before the deadline through our Careers portal. Applications submitted via email or through recruitment agencies will not be considered.
Our recruiting tool recognizes the time zone where the job ad has been published and closes the application period according to the same time zone. We will be conducting interviews with qualified candidates throughout the process and aim to keep you informed along the way.
Last application date: 21/10/2026
At Wärtsilä we value, respect and embrace all our differences, and are committed to diversity, inclusion and equal employment opportunities; everyone can be their true self and succeed based on their job-relevant merits and abilities.
Please note that according to Wärtsilä policy, voluntary consent for a security check may be required from candidates being considered for this position, depending on the applicable country.
